findings: ETT.tex:872-875, the bubble sentence ('If B is a causal bubble of J^+(p) ... then B meets K^+(p) while B∩I^+(p)=∅, so K^+(p)≠I^+(p)') is false under every hypothesis of prop:tarentin_fort_K (ETT.tex:851-852) except causal plainness, which is the setting the remark places it in. Witness: Minkowski space with one spoke, spokesCausality (Ioi 0) on R x R (Causal.KBorelien). Its chronology is Minkowski's, and ≤ adds the spacelike steps (0,x) ≤ (0,cx), x > 0, c in [0,1]. It is tarentin, absolutely minimal and causal, Hausdorff and second countable, and every point is in Z^- and Z^+. At o = (0,0), B = {(t,x) : t < 0, -t < x} is a causal bubble of J^-(o): non-empty, open, in J^-(o) because (t,x) ≪ (0,x) and then the spoke, and disjoint from I^-(o) = {|x| < -t}. Take u_n = (-1/(n+1), 0) -> o. Then J^-(u_n) ⊆ {u_n} ∪ I^-(u_n), because a spoke step ends on t = 0, above u_n. So B misses every J^-(u_n) and hence K^-(o). The mechanism fails (not_bubbleKminusAsPrinted). The same computation gives K^-(o) ⊆ I^-(o), and I^-(o) ⊆ K^-(o) holds because ≪ is open in M x M, so K^-(o) = I^-(o). The conclusion fails too (not_bubbleKminusNeAsPrinted). The K^+ form the remark prints is the time reversal (not_bubbleKplusAsPrinted, not_bubbleKplusNeAsPrinted). The same holds on R x E for every open cone A with a non-zero point (spokes_bubble_witness), for example R x C with A = C minus 0 (spokes_bubble_witness_complex). There, by hand and not formalized, J^-(o) is the whole half-space t ≤ 0 while K^-(o) = I^-(o) is the open past cone. The planner's hand route (a)-(d) went through as written, with no step changed.

ETT.tex:872 'Causal plainness cannot be dropped from Proposition prop:tarentin_fort_K' remains true; it is certified by halfChronoLine (existing causallyPlain_cannot_be_dropped), and there the bubble ]-∞,-1[ of J^-(0) does meet K^-(0) (halfChronoLine_bubble_inter_Kminus). The bubble sentence is therefore an invalid justification, not a false conclusion: a bubble neither forces nor forbids K ≠ I. The strongest true form is proved (Causality.inter_Kminus_nonempty_iff, inter_Kplus_nonempty_iff, from lem:K_facile). Let p_n -> p with p ∈ Int J^-(p_n) (for K^+). An open B ⊆ J^+(p) meets K^+(p) iff some non-empty open subset of B lies in J^+(p_n) for all large n. Since K^+(p) does not depend on the sequence, this holds for one such sequence iff it holds for every one. A sequence p ≪ p_n -> p exists at every p ∈ Z^+ of a first countable spacetime (exists_seq_inter_Kplus_nonempty_iff). When it holds, B ∩ I^+(p) = ∅ gives K^+(p) ≠ I^+(p) (Kplus_ne_Iplus_of_bubble). Suggested wording for l.872-875: 'Causal plainness cannot be dropped from Proposition prop:tarentin_fort_K. A causal bubble B of J^+(p) --- a non-empty open set contained in J^+(p) and disjoint from I^+(p), as occurs below Lipschitz regularity [MR2949547,MR3500220,samann2024nonregular] --- violates it. If B persists near p, in the sense that it contains a non-empty open set contained in J^+(p_n) for all large n, for a sequence p_n -> p with p ∈ Int J^-(p_n), then B meets K^+(p) (Lemma lem:K_facile and Remark rem:equivalent_lemma_obviously_holds) while B∩I^+(p)=∅, so K^+(p)≠I^+(p). A bubble that does not persist may miss K^+(p), and K^+(p)=I^+(p) can hold at a point whose causal future contains a bubble.' The rewording is the author's; nothing is marked.

ETT.tex:140-141 (introduction, no label; outside this target's label, reported because the same witness bears on it). The sentence says K^± 'coincides with I^± exactly where push-up holds'. Read pointwise, the 'only where' half is false. At o, K^-(o) = I^-(o), yet push-up fails at o in both of the paper's senses. Causal plainness fails at o: Int J^-(o) ⊄ cl I^-(o) (spokes_not_plain_at_origin). The relational defi:pushup also fails at o: I^-(J^-(o)) ⊄ I^-(o) (spokes_not_pushUp_at_origin). The witness also fails both properties globally. Read globally ('K^± ≡ I^± iff M causally plain'), the sentence is not addressed here: this witness has K^-(p) ≠ I^-(p) at p = (1,0), by the existing spokes_mem_Kminus with any z > 1 (prose, not restated). Suggested wording: '... which coincides with I^± wherever push-up holds ...', as ETT.tex:297-298 already says ('it agrees with I^± wherever push-up holds').
questions: The remark prints the K^+ form, but prop:tarentin_fort_K is stated for K^- at p ∈ Z^-. Reading taken: the K^+ form is quantified over the hypotheses of the K^+ analogue (rem:comparable_property_obviously_holds, ETT.tex:868-869), that is p ∈ Z^+ (BubbleKplusAsPrinted), and the past form over prop:tarentin_fort_K's own hypotheses (BubbleKminusAsPrinted). The finding does not depend on this choice, because the witness has o ∈ Z^- ∩ Z^+.

Whether 'If B is a causal bubble ... then B meets K^+(p)' is a general implication or a claim about the cited C^0 examples only (Chruściel–Grant, Sämann). Reading taken: a general implication under the other hypotheses of prop:tarentin_fort_K, as printed and as the dispatch prescribes. Nothing is claimed about the C^0 metrics, which are not in the library. Whether their bubbles persist near p in the sense of the true form is open here.
ETT.tex:140-141 'exactly where push-up holds': pointwise (at p) or global (on M)? Reading taken for the finding: pointwise. The global reading is not addressed.
Standing reading, unchanged: a causality is the library's 'equivalently' form of defi:causalite, with no gluing axiom. The finding does not depend on it, because the witness is absolutely minimal.

kb_proposals: When a bubble meets K: an open B ⊆ J^-_U(p) meets K^-_U(p) iff a non-empty open part of B lies in J^-_U(u_n) for all large n, for one (equivalently every) u_n -> p with p ∈ Int J^+_U(u_n). This is Causality.inter_Kminus_nonempty_iff (Causal.BubbleK), with K^+ forms and the Z^± existence forms exists_seq_inter_K*_nonempty_iff. A bubble alone decides nothing (T-ett-bubble-kplus).

Spokes give a cheap local witness with K^-(o) = I^-(o) while push-up fails at o in both senses. Below the slice t = 0, spokesCausality's ≤ is Minkowski's '= or ≪' (spokes_eq_or_lt_of_le), so J^-(u) ⊆ {u} ∪ I^-(u) for u.1 < 0. spokes_bubble_witness works on R x E for any open cone A with a non-zero point (T-ett-bubble-kplus).

In 'obtain ⟨…⟩ := thm isOpen_Ioi …', a set argument that only the goal fixed must be given explicitly, as (A := Ioi 0). Otherwise elaboration stops on 'typeclass instance problem is stuck: Preorder ?m'; under 'exact' the expected type supplies it (T-ett-bubble-kplus).
